integrity: All proof assertions concern the defined spectral loss; verifier diagnostics are finite checks and do not establish the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic analysis of the unsmoothed quadratic absolute-eigenvalue clustering objective. The motivating source uses additional smoothing and anti-zero logarithmic regularization. No algorithmic Krylov-rate or floating-point assertion; no independent validation. Classical inertia, Fourier projection, and graph spectral identities are credited.
title: Sharp inertia obstruction to diagonal bimodal preconditioning and a rank-one escape
